The highest rated furnace filter might be the wrong one for your house.

Those numbers measure how fine the mesh is, not how good the filter is. A denser filter catches more, and it also makes your blower work harder to pull air through it. On an older system that shows up as weaker airflow, longer run times, and a unit that wears out sooner.

Most houses do not need the top of the shelf. They need the right one, changed on time.

She doesn't move out of the way anymore. So I move the room.

She's 19. She picked her spot in the kitchen years ago and she has no intention of renegotiating it.

She used to get up when I walked through. Now she doesn't, and I decided that's my problem to solve, not hers. So I taped out her spot on the floor before I moved the counter around. The path I walk carrying something hot is never the 3 feet where she sleeps.

That's most of what senior dog care has actually been for me. Not heroics. Just moving the furniture instead of asking her to move.

Rudolph was an ad.

Robert L. May wrote him in 1939 as a free giveaway booklet for Montgomery Ward. He was in debt. His wife was dying. That was the year he wrote it.

The most cheerful character of the season came out of the worst year of a man's life.

It was always about being the one who doesn't fit.
